name: Tribology: Friction, Wear & Lubrication
summary: The science of interacting surfaces in relative motion: contact, friction, wear, lubrication and surface engineering of machine elements.

topics.name: Wear mechanisms: adhesive, abrasive, fatigue, corrosive, fretting and erosion
Lubricants: oils, greases, additives and solid lubricants
Lubrication regimes and the Stribeck curve
Hydrodynamic lubrication and the Reynolds equation
Elastohydrodynamic lubrication in gears and rolling bearings
Surface engineering and coatings (DLC, nitriding, hard coatings)
Tribological testing and tribology of seals, gears and bearings
Tribology of polymers and biomedical implants
